lines: Many countries have laws to prevent child labor.
But there are millions of children all over the world who are forced to work.
Many of them work long hours, working at factories or on farms, serving as tourist guides or selling things on the streets.
Moreover, they work in dangerous jobs.
In fact, a number of children die in accidents at work every year.
We must protect children from doing any kind of work.
Then what should we do to achieve this goal?
Education is the key to ending child labor.
When children go to school, they are less likely to work.
A better education also means a chance of getting a good job later on.
In addition, as consumers, we can help children by refusing to buy products made by them.
